cards.front: Creep is the tendency of a solid material to move slowly or deform permanently under the influence of stresses.
cards.extra: *Creep is an undesirable property of orthopaedic bio-materials because they release frictional forces necessary to maintain rigid internal fixation. In total hip arthroplasty polyethylene liners, creep is the plastic deformation of the acetabular liner that occurs due to loading without the production of wear debris or particles.
